GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-06-07T14:23:27Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Imap client.connect not giving exception when using bad port number
Description: 
Hello,

When I use this to connect to an IMAP server using SSL and port 993, it works fine.
`try
               {
                    Mailbox mailbox = db.Mailboxes.Find(mbid);
                    int mailboxcount = db.Mailboxes.Count();
                    using (var client = new ImapClient())
                    {
                         client.ServerCertificateValidationCallback = (s, c, h, e) => true;
                         client.Connect(mailbox.Host, mailbox.ServerPortNumber, mailbox.UseSsl);
                         client.AuthenticationMechanisms.Remove("XOAUTH2");
                         client.Authenticate(mailbox.User, mailbox.Password);
                         var inbox = client.Inbox;
                         inbox.Open(FolderAccess.ReadOnly);
`

If I change the port number to something like 994, it never gets to the **client.AuthenticationMechanisms.Remove("XOAUTH2");** statement.  It does not execute any of the exception catches.  It just exits the method completely.

I used the Visual Studio 2017 debugger and it makes it to the **client.Connect(mailbox.Host, mailbox.ServerPortNumber, mailbox.UseSsl);** line, but when I continue execution, it never gives any kind of error message.

I tried it in IE 11 and Mozilla Firefox.

Is there a way to catch an exception message for this error?

Thanks,
Tony
